title: Stanford Finds 26 AI Agents Dangerously Fail When Multiple Users Share Control
summary: A new benchmark called Muses-Bench stress-tests 26 frontier LLMs on multi-user scenarios, revealing how badly they handle conflicting instructions, privacy, and coordination.
